description: Read tracking results from layers: each tracker's track points (Feature Center, Feature Size, Search Offset, Search Size, Confidence, Attach Point, Attach Point Offset), or the Face Measurements and Face Track Points that detailed face tracking records, at a time and optionally every keyframe

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

keyframes.description: Also list each property's keyframes (time and value)

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

source.description: trackers (Motion Trackers) or face (the face-tracking effects)

time.description: Read values at this time in seconds. Default: the current time

name: get_tracking_data
title: Get Tracking Data
